problem: A source-level cache validation passed, but the production build generated additional HTML before localized-route generation and introduced 1926 strings that were absent from the pre-build cache. With STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 every Netlify production build failed.
root_cause: Cache completeness was measured against pre-build source while release enforcement was applied to post-build generated markup. The two string universes are not identical.
prevention: Do not make post-build cache completeness a publication prerequisite when generators can introduce new strings after cache validation.
Mark untranslated static English with data-bg-static-translated=false and hand it to the canonical runtime i18n fallback.
Keep LIVE_BEWEZEN fail-closed at the production browser verifier for /en/prijzen and visible English state.
